vrDesc: This shield identifies you as an elite soldier of Duke Akardius' army.

vars.vrWelcomeMessage:
Subject: You are now an elite soldier.
Welcome to the army of the true leader of these lands.  Your ambition suits you very well.

There are some rules imposed by those that think themselves above us.  It suits our purpose to follow these rules for now.

SOLDIER SHIELD: Your shield shows you as part of my army.  If you lose this shield, it signifies that you are no longer part of our army.

ENEMY SOLDIERS: Enemies from the other pathetic faction have full right to try to attack you when they find you.  For this, they will suffer no penalty.  Of course, you will also be unpenalized for destroying them in combat.  I am sure our cowardly foes will take shelter in safe spots like inns or halls, but it is your job to be waiting for them to leave.  As with the regular members of my faction, I will not allow traitorous attacks against those loyal to me; to do so is to reduce your own power as you are removed from my service in all aspects.  In order to better defeat our enemies, I will teach you how to do additional damage to our enemies.  Deaths inflicted upon enemies will give them the penalties they deserve for standing up to us!

RANKS: Kill our enemies, and I will see you raised to be worshipped by those that follow me.  Die or act dishonorably, and you will once again be at the lowest end of the army.  Those that try to leave this land unsafely and leave behind a ghost to escape combat will also meet with my displeasure.

ABILITIES: In return for your loyal service, I will give you power!  I will teach you how to increase your natural stamina and agility in combat.  I will also show you ways to tap into the darker aspects of magic to boost all your spells.  These powers grow as you gain my attention and ranks within the army.

THE COUNCILORS: The councilors whom we must convince do not wish you soldiers to interfere with the tokens.  For now, do as they say, for we must gain their trust if they are to declare me the true ruler I am.  Let one of my followers that is not a soldier take the token and convince the councilor of our might and our right.  Your job for now is to claim territory in my name.  Only soldiers can claim territory for our faction.

LOYALTY: Do not bother yourself with tax errands while you are a soldier.  Murder our enemies in combat and you will demonstrate all the loyalty I need.

We will take the throne of this kingdom.  You have given your support wisely.

Akardius, Duke of Blackstone Keep

vars.vrWelcomeMessage:
Subject: Welcome to the Royal army.
Greetings.  I welcome you as a new ally in our fight to keep the throne from the forces that would see us come to harm.

There are a few rules you must observe while acting as a soldier.

SOLDIER SHIELD: Your shield is the sign that you are an official part of the Royal army.  You must keep this equipped at all times in order to demonstrate your position.

ENEMY SOLDIERS: As agreed, you can be attacked by any enemy soldier in any place that is not a haven (such as a inn or hall).  Your attacker will not be recognized as a criminal for attacking or killing you.  Likewise, you can attack enemies without fear of penalty.  Note that attacking any fellow soldiers will vex me greatly, and I will remove you as a soldier and a member of my faction.  Also, our righteousness allows you to do additional damage with all your attacks to these enemy soldiers.  Please realize that deaths at the hands of enemy soldiers are real, and you will suffer the usual penalties.

RANKS: Your position within the army is determined by your actions.  Killing enemy soldiers will allow you promotion within the ranks of the army.  Being killed or remaining inactive for long periods of time will show you a decrease in rank.  Do not try to escape combat by leaving this world in unsafe areas as this will also lower your rank.

ABILITIES: With your status as a faction soldier, I will show you additional ways to increase your power.  I will make you more intelligent and able to comprehend all things mystical.  I will also teach you ways to reduce the mana cost of your spells.  The potence of these abilities will increase as you gain ranks.

THE COUNCILORS: The councilors have declared that the tokens are too delicate to be entrusted to the hands of soldiers.  Therefore, you are instructed not to pick up any tokens you may find.  I encourage you to find an ally to take the token to the proper councilor should you find one.  Likewise, the councilos have declared that only faction soldiers may claim territory now.  The flags in my chambers may now only be carried by recognized soldiers of my faction.

LOYALTY: While in the service of the royal army, I will not ask you to prove your loyalty as before.  You should concentrate on maintaining your rank.

May Shal'ille guide your actions to ensure our victory!

Signed, The Princess Kateriina, regent to Meridian.

vars.vrWelcomeMessage:
Subject: Welcome fellow freedom fighter.
I am glad to see that you are willing to become more active in our fight for the future of these lands against the forces of tyranny.

I expect a certain level of discipline from my militia soldiers.  Read these rules and follow them without question.

SOLDIER SHIELD: Your shield is the sign that you are an 'official' part of the rebel milita.  You must keep this equipped at all times in order to demonstrate your status within the rebel army.

ENEMY SOLDIERS: Be wary!  You can be attacked without penalty by those bearing the colors of our faction enemies.  Only the safety of an inn or hall will protect you from attacks.  Attacks against enemies carry no penalties, just as these enemies will not be penalized for attacking you.  Attacking a soldier allied to our faction is cause enough to be expelled dishonorably from our army.  I will teach you various ways to inflict additional damage on these enemies in order to defend yourself and to help us reclaim our place in governing this land.  You should know that any deaths at the hands of an enemy will not be lessened.

RANKS: Your position within our forces is determined by your actions.  Defeating enemy soldiers in combat will increase your rank.  Being killed or remaining idle in our fight will decrease in rank.  Also, fleeing from combat by leaving this world in unsafe areas will meet with my displeasure.  Simple enough?

ABILITIES: You will receive additional training as a soldier.  I will increase your natural might and aim through rigorous exercise.  I will also teach you to avoid damage from enemy blows.  I will, of course, spend more time with higher ranking soldiers boosting their powers than with lower ranking ones.

THE COUNCILORS: Your shield will interfere with your ability to recover tokens.  I want you to find a fellow rebel to take the token to the proper councilor should you find one.  Also know that only proper soldiers bearing shields can claim territory.  The flags in Pietro's may now only be carried and used by soldiers.

LOYALTY: A soldier like yourself is expected to find your own equipment.  However, I do not expect you to continue to supply the guards protecting our flagpoles while you maintain your status as a soldier.

Your brother in arms,

Jonas D'Accor

Before the couriers could set out, the Nexus snapped, destroying any possible route to the empire.  The Chalice was lost for centuries, thought to be absconded with by thieves.

Being one of a kind, this Chalice can not be carried in one's possession for very long or tucked away in a chest.

Thought to be an artifact from the Empire of the Nexus before this land was even discovered, this ancient shield is too old and valuable to be used in combat.

Being one of a kind, this shield can not be carried in one's possession for very long or tucked away in a chest.

This decorative piece of art was created for King Zarcos the 4th to be given to his wife on their wedding day.  Later, when Queen Joline was convicted of treason and exiled, the king ordered the heirloom destroyed because it reminded him of her.  Apparently, the orders were not completely carried out.

Being one of a kind, this heirloom can not be carried in one's possession for very long or tucked away in a chest.

Antiquarians claim there only to be a few of the priceless Minjaka Vases left in existence.  These exquisitely mastered vases use to line the throne room of Castle Victoria during the Minjakan dynasty of explorers in the second century.

Being one of a kind, this vase can not be carried in one's possession for very long or tucked away in a chest.

Excavated during the construction of the palace of the dark Princess Venya'cyr, the Urn came quickly into her possession as a valued treasure.  Ancient rumors suggest the Urn is cursed.  The craftsmanship of this priceless relic comes from unknown origins, certainly predating the Meridian settlers.  An unusual presence prevents this object from being stored in a chest or held for very long.
This mask is used by soldiers of the Squid Games.Do not let them find out who you are.
